campaign-overlay.description: The in-game campaign checklist panel. It invokes exactly three things itself: start_dragging for its unlock-to-move header (the lock switch is the panel's own toggle), hide for its close button, and set_size to fit the window to the current act's route map. No network, no filesystem.

default.description: Core window permissions plus outbound HTTPS to the read-only trade APIs of all three realms. Only the main window is listed: the login window created for 关联登录 loads an operator page and needs no Tauri API at all.
